Title: General availability: Microsoft Azure Payment HSM Service

Body.Content:
Microsoft Azure Payment HSM enables you to have native access to payment HSM in the Azure cloud. You can seamlessly migrate PCI workloads to Azure and meet the most stringent security, audit compliance, low latency, and high-performance requirements needed by the Payment Card Industry (PCI).

To learn more about Azure Payment HSM, read announcement blog
